children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Publish the dashboard and API through a trusted HTTPS edge while separating game ports, management traffic, and identity redirects.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Dashboard HTTPS and game TCP/UDP exposure are separate interfaces with different owners and security controls.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Document every HTTP, TCP, and UDP listener from DNS through the owning controller.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Separate dashboard/API, /share, and game traffic from game Services.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Select Ingress class, load balancer, DNS, and source-IP behavior.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Set one canonical external URL and exact OIDC callback/logout URLs.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Make certificate renewal, forwarded headers, WebSockets, and backend trust explicit.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use cert-manager, a certificate Secret, or another supported issuer.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Configure proxy hops, forwarded headers, timeouts, and upload limits (512m default).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Keep agent and database paths private; the API mounts only the CA cert.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Verify certificate renewal, redirects, OIDC, console WebSockets, uploads, API requests, and real client IPs end to end.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  DNS → trusted HTTPS edge → Gameplane Service

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Verify certificate, OIDC callback, console WS, upload, and API

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Record host, Ingress class, issuer, proxy CIDRs, firewall, owner
